citations.claim: The GranolaClient class manages authentication and HTTP requests to the Granola Enterprise API
The CLI is built using Typer and provides command-line interface functionality
The client uses HTTPX for HTTP operations with proper authentication headers
The list command provides options for limiting results, showing full titles, and filtering by date
The get command retrieves specific notes by ID with options for raw output and transcript inclusion
The search command allows searching notes by title with result limiting
The transcript command fetches and displays meeting transcripts
Date formatting utility converts ISO 8601 timestamps to human-readable format
Rich library is used for enhanced terminal output including console, markdown, and panels
Authentication is handled through centaur-sdk secret management system
The component integrates with Granola Enterprise API at public-api.granola.ai
External dependencies include httpx for HTTP client, typer for CLI, and rich for terminal formatting
The list_all_notes method implements pagination to fetch multiple pages of results
Search functionality performs client-side filtering after fetching notes from the API
CLI commands create GranolaClient instances for API communication
Rich tables are used to format and display note listings
The CLI provides both raw markdown and rich formatted output options
